**JOB SUMMARY**
---------------

  

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, our mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.

We are seeking a **Senior Data Analyst – Analytics Engineering & AI** to help advance our enterprise analytics capabilities and accelerate the modernization of digital analytics toward AI-supported insights.

Reporting to the **Director or Senior Manager of Analytics, AI & Insights**, this role will serve as a senior individual contributor at the intersection of **business analytics, analytics engineering, data engineering, semantic modeling, and AI-enabled analytics**.

The Senior Data Analyst will partner closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, architects, product teams, and technology partners to transform complex business questions into trusted data products, scalable analytical solutions, reusable semantic models, and actionable insights.

A key focus of the role will be creating an **AI-ready analytics foundation**—ensuring that enterprise data, business metrics, metadata, relationships, and definitions are structured so they can be consistently consumed by dashboards, analysts, conversational analytics platforms, AI agents, and other emerging analytical experiences.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking and business acumen with hands-on SQL, data modeling, analytics engineering, visualization, and modern AI/data capabilities.

**MAJOR JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-----------------------------------------

* Translate complex business questions into analytical requirements, data models, metrics, dashboards, data products, and actionable recommendations.
* Develop advanced analyses that identify trends, opportunities, root causes, customer behaviors, operational drivers, and areas for performance improvement.
* Design and maintain scalable analytical datasets and reusable data models supporting commercial, customer, digital, operational, and strategic decision-making.
* Build and maintain a trusted **semantic analytics layer** that standardizes business entities, dimensions, measures, KPIs, relationships, definitions, and calculation logic across analytical applications.
* Partner with business stakeholders and data owners to establish consistent definitions for key enterprise metrics and ensure analytics products provide a common interpretation of business performance.
* Structure data, metadata, business definitions, lineage, relationships, and contextual information to improve the ability of **AI and conversational analytics solutions** to accurately understand and reason across enterprise information.
* Support the development of **AI-enabled analytics experiences**, including conversational analytics, natural-language querying, AI-generated insights, intelligent search, and agentic analytics workflows.
* Evaluate and improve the accuracy of AI-generated analytical responses by validating metric calculations, semantic context, data mappings, source data, business rules, and analytical outputs.
* Partner with data engineering teams to design and develop reliable **ETL/ELT pipelines**, analytical data transformations, curated datasets, and reusable data products.
* Develop complex SQL transformations and use Python or similar technologies to automate analytical processes, perform advanced analysis, validate data, and improve analytical workflows.
* Perform data profiling, validation, reconciliation, and root-cause analysis to identify data-quality issues and improve confidence in enterprise analytics.
* Develop dashboards, scorecards, visualizations, and self-service analytical products that provide stakeholders with meaningful and actionable insights.
* Support experimentation, KPI measurement, customer journey analysis, forecasting, segmentation, attribution, and performance measurement as appropriate.
* Collaborate with data architecture, engineering, security, product, and governance teams to ensure analytical solutions follow enterprise standards for architecture, security, privacy, quality, and governance.
* Document analytical models, semantic definitions, transformations, business rules, data lineage, assumptions, and metric calculations to improve transparency and reuse.
* Identify opportunities to simplify and automate existing reporting and analytical processes while reducing manual data preparation and duplicated business logic.
* Contribute to the modernization of digital analytics by helping transition from traditional dashboard-centric reporting toward **AI-supported, proactive, and conversational insights**.
* Research and evaluate emerging capabilities in analytics engineering, semantic technologies, generative AI, machine learning, and modern data platforms that could improve enterprise decision-making.
* Serve as a subject-matter expert and trusted analytical partner to business and technology stakeholders, clearly communicating analytical findings, recommendations, limitations, and implications.
* Mentor analysts and other team members on analytical methodologies, SQL, data modeling, semantic design, visualization, and effective use of modern analytics technologies.

**QUALIFICATIONS (Education/Training, Experience and Certifications)**
----------------------------------------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Master's degree in a quantitative, technical, or business discipline preferred.
* 6+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, data engineering, data science, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience translating ambiguous or complex business problems into structured analytical solutions.
* Strong experience working with enterprise-scale data environments and large, complex datasets.
* Experience developing analytical data models and curated datasets for reporting, analytics, and downstream consumption.
* Experience working with cloud-based data warehouses or analytical platforms such as **Snowflake, Teradata, Hadoop, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or similar technologies**.
* Experience designing or working with **semantic models, metrics layers, dimensional models, business metadata, or governed analytical datasets**.
* Experience supporting AI-enabled analytics, conversational analytics, natural-language-to-data experiences, generative AI applications, or semantic search is preferred.
* Experience in digital analytics platforms such as **Google Analytics or Adobe Analytics** is beneficial.
* Experience integrating analytical data with enterprise systems such as SAP, ERP, CRM, digital commerce, marketing, customer, or operational systems is preferred.

title: Content strategist & Social Media Manager
description:
About the Role

We are building a fast-moving creative team in Gurgaon working across **Socialshifu, personal brands, and client accounts**.

We are looking for a **Content Strategist & Social Media Manager** who can take ownership of the complete content process — from deciding what should be created to getting it produced, scheduled and published.

This is not a traditional "post on Instagram" social media role.

We want someone who understands **content, storytelling, social media and audience behaviour**, and can turn ideas into a consistent daily content system.

What You'll Be Responsible For

**1. Content Strategy**

* Build weekly and monthly content calendars.
* Develop content pillars for each account.
* Identify what topics, formats and ideas should be explored.
* Turn current events, conversations, trends and brand activities into content opportunities.
* Develop recurring content series rather than relying only on random posts.

**2. Content Ideation**

* Generate Reel, Story, Carousel, LinkedIn and Short-form content ideas.
* Write strong hooks and content angles.
* Think about how the first 2–3 seconds of a Reel should work.
* Understand what makes people stop, watch, share and follow.
* Work closely with the Founder/Creative Director on larger creative ideas.

**3. Scripting & Briefing**

* Write or develop short-form scripts.
* Create clear briefs for video editors.
* Tell editors what footage, B-roll, references, text, pacing and structure are required.
* Convert one idea into multiple pieces of content when possible.

**4. Social Media Management**

* Manage day-to-day publishing across Instagram, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.
* Schedule posts.
* Write captions and CTAs.
* Maintain posting consistency.
* Manage Stories and supporting content.
* Ensure every piece of content is published correctly and on time.

**5. Coordinate the Editors**  
You will work directly with our two video editors.

You will:

* Assign content.
* Give editing briefs.
* Set deadlines.
* Review first cuts.
* Give feedback.
* Ensure revisions are completed.
* Maintain the content pipeline.

You should be able to say:

"These are the 10 pieces we need this week. These 4 go to Editor A, these 6 go to Editor B, these 2 need fresh footage, and these 3 are ready to schedule."

**6. Content Performance**

* Track views, watch time, retention, shares, saves, comments, profile visits and follower growth.
* Identify which hooks and formats are working.
* Learn from performance rather than blindly following trends.
* Adjust the next week's content based on data.

**7. Content Repurposing**  
One shoot or piece of content should not necessarily become only one post.

You should look for opportunities to turn:

* One interview → multiple Reels
* One event → Reels + Stories + photos + LinkedIn
* One long video → multiple Shorts
* One idea → multiple content formats

Accounts You'll Work On

Initially, you may work across three different types of accounts:

**Socialshifu**

* Our own brand.
* AI-powered content and advertising.
* Startup/product storytelling.
* Creative work and portfolio.

**Personal Brand**

* Build authority and credibility.
* Business/networking content.
* Meetings, events, insights and relationships.
* Content that strengthens his personal brand.

**Client Account**

* A professional client account where content quality, consistency and approvals are critical.

Each account has a different objective, so you should understand that **the same content strategy cannot be copied across every account.**

What We're Looking For

We care more about **thinking ability and execution** than certificates.

You should:

* Understand Instagram and short-form content deeply.
* Have strong content instincts.
* Be able to write good hooks and scripts.
* Understand storytelling.
* Have a good sense of trends without blindly copying them.
* Understand basic analytics.
* Be highly organised.
* Be comfortable managing multiple content calendars.
* Communicate clearly with editors and creatives.
* Take ownership of deadlines.
* Be proactive rather than waiting for instructions.
* Have strong attention to detail.
* Be comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment.

The Most Important Quality

**Ownership.**

We are not looking for someone who needs to be told every morning what to do.

We want someone who can look at the accounts and say:

"This is what we should publish this week, this is why, these are the assets we need, and this is how we're going to execute it."

You will have creative direction and support from the founder, but you should be capable of **running the day-to-day content operation independently.**

Who This Role Is NOT For

This may not be the right role if your experience is mainly:

* Uploading posts
* Copy-pasting captions
* Canva-only social media work
* Waiting for someone to provide every idea
* Following trends without understanding them
* Managing only one small account
* Needing constant supervision

Preferred Experience

**1–3+ years** in social media, content, digital marketing, creator management or a similar role is preferred.

However, **strong portfolio > years of experience**.

Someone with 1 year of excellent work can be more valuable than someone with 4 years of average work.

Practical Hiring Task

Shortlisted candidates will be given a practical assignment:

You will receive three different accounts and will be asked to create a **7-day content plan** including:

* Content ideas
* Hooks
* Formats
* Posting schedule
* Basic scripts
* Content pillars
* Editor requirements
* Reasoning behind your choices

We want to see **how you think**, not just what is written on your CV.

Location

**Gurgaon, Haryana**

**On-site role**

We are building a small creative studio environment and this role will work closely with the founders and creative team.

Compensation

**₹30,000–₹40,000/month**, depending on experience, portfolio and execution ability.

Exceptional candidates may be considered separately.

Team Structure

You will work closely with:

**Founder / Creative Director**  
Creative direction, business, client relationships and major campaign ideas.

**Video Editor 1**  
High-volume social content and Reels.

**Video Editor 2**  
Creative/AI-powered advertising and premium content.

**Freelance Shooters**  
On-location production when required.

The Goal

Your job is ultimately to build a **content engine**.

Not just:

"Post every day."

But:

Idea → Strategy → Script → Production → Editing → Approval → Publishing → Analytics → Learning → Next Idea.

You will own that pipeline.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

title: UX Researcher | India
description:
**About AnswerLab**

AnswerLab helps pioneering leaders Own the Unknown, transforming uncharted territory into clarity, direction, and competitive advantage. We build strategic insight through deep human understanding and validating future possibilities with real people in real contexts. We believe that the future of experience strategy relies on continuous learning and cross-functional expertise, enabling us to guide clients through unprecedented challenges across every phase of the product lifecycle.

**Role Summary**

As a UX Researcher, you will join our Rapid Research program, a dedicated, embedded research team that delivers fast, high-quality insights (typically within 1–2 weeks) to a major global technology client.

Rapid Researchers are based across the US, EMEA (UK, Zurich), and APAC (India, Korea), providing global research coverage for the client's key audiences, including General Populations, Content Creators, Teens, and accessibility-focused populations.

This remote role is based in India and adds dedicated coverage and Hindi-language research capabilities to the program, enabling the team to conduct research with both Hindi and English-speaking participants, and to better support stakeholders across the region and in other international markets, including US-based stakeholders.

You'll spend the majority of your time leading Rapid Research studies end-to-end, with the opportunity to contribute to longer-form Custom Research projects (e.g., diary studies, benchmarking, or focus groups), as needed.

You are passionate about research: you love learning new methods, testing new tools and technologies, and thinking deeply about the human-centered issues we face as researchers. You see yourself as a partner to stakeholders, bringing them into the research process and listening closely to their needs.

You're proactive, adaptable, and organized, with time management skills to keep multiple fast-moving studies on track simultaneously. Rapid Researchers are typically prepping their next study while fielding and reporting on the current one.

Ideal candidates have at least 4 years of hands-on experience leading research studies and partnering with stakeholders or clients throughout the research process.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Rapid Research Delivery

* Lead Rapid Research studies end-to-end, delivering fast, high-quality insights within a 1–2 week (or accelerated 1-week sprint) timeframe.
* Consult on research methodology and scope, and develop kickoff/alignment documents and moderator guides
* Moderate remote and in-person interviews (In-Depth Interviews, unmoderated studies, heuristic evaluations) with Viewers, Creators, Teens, or accessibility-focused participants
* Conduct literature reviews and competitive analyses as needed
* Deliver end-of-day session summaries during fielding and lead key-takeaway alignment with stakeholders
* Analyze findings and develop final reports (slide decks of ~30 slides, or written docs) with clear, actionable recommendations
* Present findings in stakeholder readouts

  

2. Client Stakeholder Partnership

* Build trusted relationships with stakeholders, bringing consultative guidance to every study.
* Provide consultative guidance and proactively recommend solutions to keep research moving forward
* Coordinate closely with the recruiting team on participant screening and scheduling, flagging special or advanced recruit needs early
* Support Hindi-language studies and localization needs, serving as a regional point of contact for India specific research questions

  

3. Program & Process Excellence

* Keep projects on track and contribute to the continuous improvement of the Rapid Research program.
* Keep projects on schedule and within scope, managing multiple concurrent studies at different stages (prep, fielding, reporting)
* Explore creative solutions to research challenges, including recommending improvements to internal processes or best practices
* Continue developing your research and consultative skills, and contribute to AnswerLab's knowledge library and internal training initiatives
* Contribute to Custom Research projects (2+ week timelines) as a nice-to-have, such as focus groups, diary studies, benchmarking, surveys, card sorting, contextual inquiry, or Critical User Journey (CUJ) audits

  

**Key Relationships**

* Reports to: Research Manager (UK-based)
* Close collaboration with: UX Research peers across all markets (APAC, EMEA, US), Research Manager (US-based), Project Manager
* Client engagement: Active coordination with client stakeholders

  

**Knowledge, Skills, & Experience**

We know outstanding candidates come from a range of backgrounds. We are looking for people with the personal characteristics to thrive in a growing, client-focused, purpose-driven business. The ideal candidate will meet many of the criteria below.

**Experience**

* 4+ years of hands-on experience conducting qualitative UX or market research, including experience leading studies end-to-end
* Native/fluent fluency in Hindi and business-level fluency in English, with the ability to moderate research sessions and write deliverables in both languages
* Experience partnering with clients/stakeholders in a consulting or agency environment, or an equivalent research background
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities across concurrent studies, and meet fast-moving deadlines

  

**Research Craft**

Skilled in core Rapid Research methodologies:

* In-depth interviews
* Unmoderated studies
* Heuristic evaluation
* Literature review
* Competitive analysis

Familiarity with a broader range of methodologies is a nice-to-have:

  

* Focus groups
* Diary studies
* Benchmarking
* Surveys
* Card sorting
* Contextual inquiry
* Critical User Journeys
* Strong presentation skills, including building decks and presenting results and recommendations to senior stakeholders

  

**Organization & Communication**

* Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and a strong commitment to accuracy and completeness
* Exceptional time management skills with the ability to prioritize effectively across competing demands
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong interpersonal abilities
* Comfortable using online/remote research tools (e.g., Google Meet, Zoom, dscout, GSuite)
* Responsive, service-oriented, and client-focused in all interactions

  

**Mindset & Values**

* Curious, enthusiastic, and energized by a fast-paced, problem-solving environment
* Self-motivated, quick learner who thrives with minimal supervision
* Collaborative team player with a strong sense of ownership and follow-through
* Committed to inclusive, empathetic collaboration and contributing to a workplace where diverse talent thrives

  

**Education**

Undergraduate and/or advanced degree, preferably in:

* Experimental Psychology
* Cognitive Psychology
* Human Factors
* Human-Computer Interaction
* Or a related field with a foundation in research-based design

  

**Additional Requirements**

Willingness to collaborate across multiple time zones (e.g., APAC, EMEA, and US-based partners), which may occasionally require scheduling flexibility and extended hours to meet project deadlines

Ability to work at a computer for extended periods of time

**Location Eligibility**

Home-based/remote, located in India, with up to 15% travel (including occasional in-person sessions at regional lab spaces)

Must be comfortable leading projects independently and collaborating virtually across APAC, EMEA, and US time zones, which may occasionally require schedule flexibility

Candidates must have current work authorization in India; AnswerLab cannot sponsor visas for this role.

No staffing or recruiting agencies.

* **Be the Connective Tissue:** Turn a vague request into a clear problem, and get Product and Engineering agreed on it before you start designing. You’ll know which constraints are real and which are assumed, and bring Engineering in early enough to shape the work.
* **Champion Quality:** Run critique that makes other people’s work stronger, not just different, and hold the bar from concept through final build. You’ll sort out disagreements between Product and Engineering rather than waiting for someone else to.

* **Uncover Insights:** Write the research plan for your area and partner with our researchers as a peer rather than filing a request. You’ll read the numbers and the interviews together as a pair.
* **Advocate for the User:** Turn research findings into meaningful product changes, ensuring the "voice of the customer" is the loudest voice in the room. You’ll decide what a traveler needs to know and when, and cut the copy that serves the business rather than the customer.

### **Scale the Vision**

* **Evolve the System:** Contribute patterns to Horizon properly, with their states, variants, accessibility notes, and reasoning, and then get other teams actually using them. So every team can build faster on shared standards.

title: Senior Product Manager, Fraud & Risk
description:
**About Tala**

Tala is the AI-native credit infrastructure that connects global capital to the global majority. We combine proprietary risk intelligence with an expanding network of capital and distribution partners to power credit access at scale. To date, Tala has distributed more than $9 billion in capital to more than 14 million customers across Africa, Latin America, and Asia, building the definitive contextual dataset on thin-file borrowers in emerging markets. Tala is now converting that foundation into shared infrastructure that partners, capital providers, and ecosystems can build on.
  
  
The company has been named to the Fortune Impact 20 list, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies twice, CNBC Disruptor 50 for five years, and Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for ten years running.

Given the global nature of our team, we operate on a remote-first approach with office hubs in Santa Monica, CA (HQ); Nairobi, Kenya; Mexico City, Mexico; Manila, the Philippines; and Bangalore, India.

Most Talazens join us because they connect with our mission. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Tala, we’d love to hear from you!

### **The Role**

Tala is on a mission to unleash the economic power of the global majority. We’re building financial services that give people greater access, control, and agency over their financial lives.

As Tala continues to scale, protecting our customers while creating a seamless experience is more important than ever. We’re looking for aSenior Product Manager, Fraud & Authentication to lead the strategy and execution of the systems that keep our customers and platform safe.

As the Senior Product Manager, Fraud & Authentication, you’ll own Tala’s product strategy for fraud prevention, customer authentication, and identity-related experiences across the customer journey.

You’ll tackle complex problems at the intersection of fraud, risk, machine learning, data, engineering, and customer experience.

Your goal will be to help Tala identify and prevent fraudulent activity while minimizing unnecessary friction for legitimate customers.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Lending, Finance, Customer Care, Marketing, Legal, and other global teams to turn complex fraud patterns and ambiguous problems into scalable products and systems.

This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who enjoys solving difficult problems with data, moving quickly, and building products that have a measurable impact on both customers and the business.

### **What You'll Do**

### **Own Fraud & Authentication Product Strategy**

* Define and own Tala’s multi-year product strategy and roadmap for fraud prevention, customer authentication, identity, and related risk capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to improve fraud prevention across signup, login, account management, and other high-risk customer actions.
* Balance fraud prevention with customer experience by reducing fraud losses and false positives while minimizing unnecessary friction.
* Translate complex fraud patterns, emerging attack vectors, and business needs into clear product strategies and priorities.

### **Build Data-Driven Fraud Products**

* Partner closely with Data Science and Analytics to define model objectives, evaluate model and feature performance, and identify opportunities to improve detection.
* Help determine appropriate fraud decision thresholds and rules based on data and business objectives.
* Establish and monitor key metrics such as fraud loss rates, detection accuracy, false-positive rates, customer conversion, and authentication success.
* Identify data gaps and work with technical teams to improve the data and infrastructure needed to make effective fraud decisions.
* Collaborate on fraud detection models, rules, feature infrastructure, and decisioning systems.

### **Lead Product Execution**

* Translate ambiguous fraud and authentication problems into clear product requirements that Engineering teams can execute against.
* Lead a cross-functional team of engineers and partners to deliver the roadmap.
* Prioritize initiatives based on customer impact, fraud exposure, business value, technical complexity, and data.
* Partner with Engineering to understand Tala’s fraud and authentication infrastructure and identify opportunities to improve scalability and reliability.
* Drive initiatives from strategy and discovery through launch, measurement, and iteration.

### **Manage Fraud & Risk Events**

* Partner with Data Science, Analytics, Engineering, and Operations to investigate fraud incidents and emerging fraud patterns.
* Turn lessons from fraud events into proactive product and system improvements.
* Develop approaches that allow Tala to respond quickly as fraud patterns and attack vectors evolve.

### **Collaborate Across Tala**

* Build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Lending, Finance, Customer Care, Marketing, and Legal.
* Communicate complex fraud and risk concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Manage relationships with external vendors and technology partners supporting fraud, authentication, identity, or risk capabilities.
* Create alignment across distributed global teams and drive decisions in an environment where information may be incomplete or ambiguous.

### **What You'll Need**

* 5+ years of Product Management experience, with experience owning complex technical products or platforms.
* Proven experience building or managing products related to fraud, risk, authentication, identity, KYC, account security, payments, lending, or financial crime.
* Experience partnering closely with Engineering and Data Science to build fraud detection, risk decisioning, authentication, or identity solutions.
* Experience using data and metrics to make product decisions and measure outcomes.
* Experience managing fraud incidents, emerging fraud patterns, or other high-impact risk events.
* Ability to translate complex and ambiguous problems into clear product requirements and actionable roadmaps.
* Experience managing external vendors or technology partners.
* Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills.
* Comfort operating in a fast-paced, distributed, and highly collaborative environment.

Our vision is to build a new financial ecosystem where everyone can participate on equal footing and access the tools they need to be financially healthy. We strongly believe that inclusion fosters innovation and we’re proud to have a diverse global team that represents a multitude of backgrounds, cultures, and experience. We hire talented people regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**Position Overview**  
  
The **Experienced Product Owner** is an experienced, functionally deep Workday professional who owns one or more Workday modules end-to-end on behalf of Revantage and its PortCos. This is not a passive coordination role — it is an active, hands-on domain mastery role. You are the subject-matter expert, the decision-maker, the stakeholder champion, and the product strategist for your assigned module(s). You will work across a complex multi-PortCo environment, running user forums, managing the release roadmap, driving adoption, and continuously finding ways to extract more value from the platform. **Key Responsibilities**  
  
**Domain Ownership & Functional Mastery**

  

* Own your assigned Workday module(s): **Compensation & Advance Compensation** end-to-end — from strategy and design through configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
* Develop and maintain deep functional expertise in your domain(s), staying current with Workday product updates, roadmap changes, and community best practices.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation resource for your module area across all PortCos.
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of how your module(s) interact with upstream and downstream systems and processes — and design solutions with those dependencies in mind.
* Think beyond Workday: identify complementary or supplementary technologies that could enhance capability in your domain — whether that is AI-powered tools, third-party integrations, or adjacent platforms.

**PortCo Engagement & Stakeholder Management**

  

* Build and maintain strong relationships with HR leaders, operations teams, and business stakeholders across multiple PortCos.
* Act as a trusted advisor — understanding each PortCo's unique workforce model, business context, and HR priorities.
* Run structured Product Owner forums, working groups, and user communities to surface requirements, share updates, and drive alignment.
* Manage competing priorities across PortCos with transparency — communicating trade-offs, timelines, and decisions clearly to all stakeholders.
* Facilitate requirements workshops and design sessions, translating business needs into clear, actionable Workday solutions.

**Roadmap & Release Ownership**

  

* Own and maintain the product roadmap for your module(s) — balancing strategic enhancements, PortCo-driven requirements, bug fixes, and Workday release adoption.
* Evaluate every Workday bi-annual release for impact and opportunity within your domain — leading opt-in decisions, testing, and rollout planning.
* Prioritize the backlog in collaboration with stakeholders, the Functional Architect, and People Technology leadership.
* Ensure all enhancements are delivered with appropriate change management, training, and communications to end users and HR teams.
* Track and report on the delivery and benefit realization of roadmap initiatives.

**Hands-On Delivery**

  

* Remain hands-on with Workday configuration in your module area — able to configure, test, validate and deploy.
* Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for enhancements and releases within your domain.
* Create design documents, configuration specifications, and test plans before deployment.
* Own day-to-day delivery.

**Ecosystem & Innovation Thinking**

  

* Continuously evaluate the HR technology landscape for innovations relevant to your module area — e.g., AI in recruiting, manager effectiveness tools, payroll analytics.
* Propose and build the business case for technology enhancements or new tool adoption where Workday alone does not fully meet business needs.
* Collaborate with vendors (Workday, Paradox, HiredScore, Peakon, etc.) to stay ahead of product developments and advocate for Revantage's priorities.

* 5+ years of Workday functional experience with deep, hands-on expertise in at least two Workday modules.
* Demonstrated experience owning a Workday module in a production environment — including enhancements, releases, stakeholder management, and roadmap ownership.
* Nice to have experience working in a multi-entity, multi-PortCo, or shared-services HR technology model.
* Strong understanding of Workday business process configuration, security roles, reporting, and calculated fields.
* Proven ability to engage and influence senior HR stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience running forums, steering committees, or user communities across a distributed stakeholder base.
* Global Workday implementation or support experience — able to navigate multi-jurisdiction complexity.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for business audiences and vice versa.

**Module-specific Experience (by Role): Compensation & Advanced Compensation**  
  
Salary structures, merit and bonus planning, compensation cycles, and global pay practices — configuration and operational support.

* **Compensation Structures:** Grade profiles, salary ranges, pay bands, compensation plans (salary, hourly, allowance), and eligibility rules.
* **Merit & Bonus Planning:** Merit matrices, bonus plan configuration, target amounts, proration rules, and manager worksheet setup.
* **Compensation Cycles:** Annual and off-cycle review configuration, approval routing, budget pools, and cycle administration.
* **Advanced Compensation:** Long-term incentive plans, equity award management, one-time payments, and complex plan eligibility.
* **Global Pay Practices:** Multi-currency compensation, country-specific allowances, cost-of-living adjustments, and grade localization.
* **Integrations & Reporting:** Payroll input mapping, compensation statement generation, comp data audits, and Prism-ready pay analytics

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Workday Pro certification in one or more relevant modules.
* Experience with third-party HR technology integrations and vendor management.
* Exposure to change management methodologies and communication planning.
* Prior experience in private equity, financial services, or multi-company real estate environments.
* Familiarity with Agile or product management frameworks (backlog management, sprint planning, road mapping tools).

Revantage is a Blackstone portfolio company and a leading provider of corporate services across Blackstone's Real Estate portfolio. We are seeking a Digital Product Manager, to join the AI & Data Innovation Lab Product Management Team. **Manager, Product Management — Sourcing & Procurement**

**Zora AI™ by Deloitte | Deloitte Consulting Products (USI)**

**About the Role**

Zora AI™ by Deloitte is Deloitte's agentic AI platform, delivering role- and function-specific products — including Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Customer, and Human Capital — built on the NVIDIA AI stack and underpinned by Deloitte's Trustworthy AI™ framework.

Deloitte is looking for a hands-on Product Manager to own the **Sourcing & Procurement product area** within Zora AI end-to-end. Based in US-India (USI Office), you'll own the roadmap, the team, and the outcomes for a defined slice of the procurement portfolio — spanning requisitioning, sourcing and RFx, contract management, supplier onboarding and collaboration, and purchase-to-pay — turning real practitioner pain points into digital workers that deliver measurable value. You'll set direction in partnership with the Product Lead, run discovery and delivery across multiple workstreams, and bring deep procurement domain expertise to every decision, all while ensuring trust, adoption, and business impact for enterprise users.

This is a builder's role with real ownership: you're accountable not just for what your team ships, but for the vision, prioritization, and people behind it. You'll work closely with US-based product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders, and you'll mentor and grow the Consultants and Analysts around you.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Own Your Product**

* Own the roadmap, backlog, and outcomes for the Sourcing & Procurement product area, and take a lead role — alongside the Product Lead — in shaping the 12–18 month vision and strategy
* Make prioritization and trade-off calls across multiple workstreams (requisition, sourcing/RFx, contract management, supplier onboarding, purchase-to-pay), sequencing by value, effort, and readiness
* Define and own the KPIs that prove impact: adoption, efficiency gains, cost reduction, supplier performance, and workflow completion
* Know when something isn't working — flag it early, make the case to change course, and retire low-value work fast

* Take features and agent capabilities from concept through define, shape, build, and scale

* Own launch, adoption, and iteration — instrument the product and act on what the telemetry and voice-of-customer data show
* Work in an AI-native way, using AI and agentic workflows across discovery, build, and delivery

**Trust & Governance**

* Partner with risk, compliance, and cybersecurity teams to define evaluation approach, monitoring plans, auditability, and governance requirements aligned to the Trustworthy AI™ framework
* Own trust and audit-readiness outcomes for your product area, including policy adherence and reduction of high-severity model risks

**Clients & Go-to-Market**

* Stay close to clients — lead demos, discovery sessions, and feedback conversations with procurement leaders and category managers, and turn what you hear into roadmap decisions
* Own go-to-market inputs for your area: positioning, pricing/packaging input, demos, and enablement, partnering with sales, alliances, and delivery on pursuits, pilots, and launches
* Stay fluent in the market realities shaping procurement products: data privacy, ERP/CRM ecosystems, connector marketplaces, and SaaS vs. on-prem considerations

* Partner with Deloitte Consulting Delivery and Practice teams across India to align the product area with delivery capacity and real client needs

* **Adoption:** active users, repeat usage, workflow completion rates, feature utilization

Remote + hybrid model (typically 2–3 days onsite), with flexibility based on team and client needs, operating in agile product teams on a regular release cadence.

* Fluent in discovery and validation — user research, hypothesis testing, experimentation — not just delivery

Great products are built by people who stay close to the user and close to the craft — and great product organizations are built by people who can also lead others to do the same. You are the subject-matter expert, the decision-maker, the stakeholder champion, and the product strategist for your assigned module(s). * Own your assigned Workday module(s): Talent & Performance end-to-end — from strategy and design through configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.

* Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation resource for your module area across all PortCos.
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of how your module(s) interact with upstream and downstream systems and processes — and design solutions with those dependencies in mind.
* Think beyond Workday: identify complementary or supplementary technologies that could enhance capability in your domain — whether that is AI-powered tools, third-party integrations, or adjacent platforms.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with HR leaders, operations teams, and business stakeholders across multiple PortCos.

* Own and maintain the product roadmap for your module(s) — balancing strategic enhancements, PortCo-driven requirements, bug fixes, and Workday release adoption.

description:
**he Company**

Kantata gives professional services organizations the clarity, control, and confidence they need to optimize resource planning, project management, and financial management - all to improve business outcomes for both the professional services firms we serve and their clients. Our purpose-built professional services automation software empowers over 2,500 professional services organizations in more than 100 countries to deliver radically better business outcomes. Kantata provides AI-powered insights and next best action recommendations our clients need to win more business and optimize project delivery to exceed their clients’ expectations.

Kantata is well-capitalized, hiring, and growing our loyal and diversified customer base faster than we ever have. Most importantly, we have a clear vision of where we’re going and how to get there. (Hint: It involves you.) Did we mention that Kantata is also an awesome place to work? You’ll have the opportunity to work in a dynamic environment with a team that loves what they do. A talented team, great perks, and an amazing culture = an employee-rated Best Place to Work!

**About the Opportunity**

We are looking for an experienced Sr. Product Marketing Manager to join our growing PMM team. This individual will be a key driver in supporting all phases of the product marketing lifecycle - bringing new solutions to market as well as managing product performance in market. This position will create compelling GTM narratives as well as drive GTM execution. The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of enterprise SaaS solutions marketing, a passion for storytelling, and a proven track record of collaborating cross-functionally to create compelling narratives and collateral such as solution presentations, sales enablement content, FAQs, web content and much more.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Orchestrate and execute product launches, new features, and major updates, collaborating closely with Product Management, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success and Professional Services teams.
* Create high-impact marketing collateral and content that addresses our target ICP and personas’ critical business issues (CBIs), refine value propositions, and craft differentiated narratives that resonate with key targeted personas.
* Work closely with the enablement to train sales, solution consultants, customer success teams, and professional services - ensuring they are equipped with the right messaging and collateral to effectively position and sell our products.
* Collaborate with our Campaign and Demand Generation teams to create high ROI campaigns, monitor campaign performance and recommend corrective actions to achieve targets.
* Conduct market research and gather competitive intelligence to identify market trends, customer needs, and competitive positioning. Mine Kantata’s Sales, Marketing and Customers Success data (e.g. - Salesforce CRM, Gong calls, GainSight) to uncover insights.
* Translate market insights into actionable recommendations to improve product positioning and promotion as well as develop strategies to effectively address competitors’ positioning.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related field; MBA a plus.
* 7+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS product marketing.
* Prior experience either selling to or working in professional services strongly desired.
* Proven track record of successfully launching and marketing B2B SaaS solutions.
* Strong understanding of enterprise B2B sales cycles and buyer journeys.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, concise, and compelling marketing narratives.
* Demonstrated ability to conduct market research, competitive analysis, and derive actionable insights.
* Experience developing and delivering sales enablement content and training.
* Strategic thinker with a strong analytical mindset and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work remotely, independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Proficiency with sales systems and reporting tools,(e.g. Salesforce, Gong), Sales Enablement tools (e.g. Seismic), Customer Success tools (e.g. GainSight) and project management (e.g. Asana) tools is a plus.

Our Philosophy

We know every company can be successful with the right technology and when people are at the core. We believe that we’re better together - that working hand-in-hand brings the best thoughts to the table and creates an environment of learning and growth. Here, you’ll enjoy:

* An intentionally engaging and collaborative culture - ditch the silo!
* Strong work-life balance that’s a true focus of the company
* The chance to learn from some of the best people in the business
* A vibrant, collaborative, and devoted team, who still makes time for fun

At Kantata, we strive to create an inclusive workplace that upholds the dignity of all people. We value, respect, and celebrate everyone’s unique strengths from all different walks of life. As we continue to cultivate diversity within the company, our product (and people!) innovation continues to flourish.  
  
Kantata is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Kantata is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions at Kantata are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

description:
**Level Up Your Career!**

At Kwalee, you’ll join a gaming powerhouse that boasts a mobile empire with 1.5 billion+ downloads alongside a thriving PC & Console division that has achieved numerous global chart-topping releases across Steam, Consoles, and Amazon, driving millions of Wishlists. Most recently publishing breakout hits such as The Precinct and Town to City. It’s a unique chance to bring your expertise to a global studio that dominates both the mobile, and the indie PC and Console space.

At Kwalee, as well as a competitive salary we also offer; Private Medical Insurance, door-to-door transport scheme, free food & drinks, free game codes & merch, LinkedIn Learning, 20 annual leave days + bank holidays, and 1 day extra day for each year of service capped at 5.

**Join the team!**  

Kwalee’s Product & Growth team is looking for a Senior or Lead Product Manager to shape what comes next in our live games: what we change, why, and what it will earn.

You’ll team up with our Executive Producers: they lead how we build, you lead what we build and why, and together you make our games better and better.

We’ll match the title to your experience. This role is for you if you’re a product leader who loves living in player data, forming bold hypotheses about retention, engagement, and monetisation, running clean experiments, and turning results into confident decisions.

This role is based in our Bangalore studio, working onsite 5 days per week, where our daily in-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation.

### **What You’ll Do:**

* **Understand the games inside out.** Know the key numbers for each game, find the biggest opportunities in retention, engagement, economy, and monetisation, and size them.
* **Start with a hypothesis.** Turn every opportunity into a clear hypothesis with a success metric, so every feature ships with a purpose.
* **Run experiments that decide.** Design A/B tests with our product analysts, read them with an open mind, and decide together with the producer what ships next.
* **Shape the roadmap.** Build and prioritise the game roadmap with the Executive Producer, ranked by the value it will create.
* **Connect growth and product.** Bring what UA and creative learn about our players into the games, and work with monetisation on the best player experience.
* **Grow the product craft.** Guide our product analysts and help set how we do product across the portfolio.
* **Spot tomorrow’s hits.** Bring a product view to our most promising new games as they grow.

### **What You’ll Own:**

Great product decisions and the extra player value that they will create in our biggest games.

You’ll be the champion who ensures every big player opportunity gets a smart hypothesis, a clear experiment, and a place on the roadmap.

**How we’ll celebrate your success:**

* Growth in LTV and profit from product changes
* Retention, engagement, and monetisation in your games
* Experiments launched, learned from, and shipped
* Clear, well-reasoned roadmap decisions

### **What We’re Looking For:**

**Essential**

* Senior product management experience in F2P mobile games, with live games you’ve measurably improved.
* Strong analytical skills: at home with cohorts, funnels, and experiment design; A great understanding of game economies, progression, LiveOps, and hybrid monetisation.
* A hypothesis-driven mindset: you know what you expect to happen, why, and what you’ll do if you’re wrong.
* Experience partnering closely with producers or game leads
* A clear, warm communicator who makes the case in players and pounds.

**Desirable**

* SQL experience.
* Experience guiding or mentoring analysts.
* Puzzle or hybrid-casual mobile game experience

### **Why Kwalee?**

* **Generous Holiday:** Start with 20 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays. You'll also earn an extra day for every year of service, up to 5 years!
* **Flexible Working:** We offer core hours that allow you to work flexibly around your life, and a bank of 'Work From Home' days to use when you need them.
* **Health Cover:** Private Medical Insurance covering you and your family
* **Free Food & Drink:** Fuel your day with unlimited free snacks and drinks.
* **Gaming Goodies:** Receive Steam codes for all our game releases!
* **Transport:** Save on your commute with our budget-friendly, door-to-door transport facility.
* **Office Location:** Work from our Bangalore office immersing yourself in the dynamic heart of India's Silicon Valley, where explosive career opportunities seamlessly blend with a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle and fantastic year-round weather.
* **Professional Development:** Take advantage of our corporate LinkedIn Learning subscription to enhance your skill set
* **Merch & Events:** Get exclusive Kwalee merch, enjoy fun seasonal events, and stay informed with regular town halls.

### **Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion**

At Kwalee, we take pride in being an equal opportunity employer, where we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to driving creativity. We are committed to creating a safe, welcoming, and supportive environment where everyone can thrive.

Operations and Product Support / Business Operations. The role will build a cohesive, scalable organization with strong
  
operational delivery, stakeholder management, talent development, process integration and continuous improvement
  
across product and lifecycle-related activities.

**Job Description**

**Senior Manager Product and Lifecycle Management**

  

**About Medline**

Medline is the largest provider of medical-surgical products and supply chain solutions serving all points of care. Through its broad product portfolio, resilient supply chain and leading clinical solutions, Medline helps healthcare providers improve their clinical, financial and operational outcomes. Headquartered in Northfield, Ill., the company employs more than 45,000 people worldwide and operates in more than 100 countries. To learn more about how Medline makes healthcare run better, visit www.medline.com .

  

**Medline India**

Medline India was established in 2010 in Pune as Global Capability Center to support Medline, headquartered in Illinois, USA. Over the years, it has grown into a 1,800+ strong team of technology, finance, and business support professionals who contribute to Medline’s global mission: to make healthcare run better. Medline India offers a dynamic and collaborative work environment with ample opportunities to learn, innovate, and grow. With a highly engaged and empowered team, Medline India plays a vital role in driving business excellence and supporting healthcare systems across the globe.

  

**Job Summary:**

Lead and integrate a global operations capability supporting the lifecycle of healthcare products and procedure kits, from product and component setup through controlled changes, commercial enablement, inventory management and discontinuation. The role connects product information, technical documentation, supply chain execution and business analytics to improve product availability, data quality, turnaround time and financial outcomes.

The Senior Manager will lead through managers and team leaders, establish a common operating model across the combined teams, and partner with global Product Management, Supply Chain, Commercial, Quality and Regulatory, and Technology leaders. The mandate includes building specialist talent, delivering reliable operations, and converting analytics, automation and AI opportunities into measurable improvements.

  

**Business scope**
------------------

· Kitting and lifecycle operations: new and revised kit setup, bill of materials maintenance, component changes, kit activation and closure, discontinued business, inventory disposition and lifecycle exceptions.

· Product information and technical support: product master data, technical data sheets, labeling and instructions for use support, packaging information, translations, product cross references and controlled documentation.

· Commercial and supply chain enablement: quotations and pricing support, vendor and sourcing administration, product availability and backorder insights, tender information and coordination across product divisions.

· Analytics and transformation: business intelligence, product and component analysis, workflow automation, project governance, process standardization and capability expansion.

  

**Responsibilities:**

**Product and lifecycle accountabilities**
==========================================

**Kitting and lifecycle operations**
------------------------------------

· Own service delivery for kit and component setup, bill of materials changes, revisions, activation and closure. Establish checks that keep approved product, quotation, packaging and system information consistent across handoffs.

· Coordinate new, revised and discontinued business with Product Management, planning, manufacturing, purchasing and customer-facing teams. Manage dependencies, exceptions and escalation to protect continuity of supply.

· Lead the operational response to excess, obsolete and expiring inventory, component shortages, revision runout and customer cancellations. Use analysis to recommend transfers, returns, purchase order actions or disposition for approval by the accountable business owner.

**Product data and documentation**
----------------------------------

· Establish ownership and quality controls for product attributes, descriptions, packaging hierarchies, images, component data and cross references. Resolve data defects at source and maintain consistency across product information and ERP systems.

· Oversee technical data sheet creation and updates, labeling and artwork coordination, instructions for use documentation, translation workflows and document publication. Maintain version control, traceability and evidence of required reviews.

· Strengthen controls for product changes, component discontinuations and related document updates so that approved changes reach the affected systems, users and downstream processes.

**Technical and product development support**
---------------------------------------------

· Lead the assigned support for supplier information, product specifications, sample review coordination, packaging study documentation and project milestones. Ensure requirements, acceptance criteria, dependencies and outstanding decisions are clearly documented.

· Partner with Product Management, Quality and Regulatory specialists on technical reviews and change decisions. Exercise approval authority only within formally assigned responsibilities and approved procedures.

**Commercial and supplier enablement**
--------------------------------------

· Oversee quotation and pricing administration, component cost and margin analysis, product replacement information, tender responses and product documentation requests. Ensure business recommendations use validated information and reach the authorized decision maker.

· Direct assigned vendor setup, vendor data maintenance, purchasing support and pricing or invoice exception workflows. Improve coordination with Procurement, Finance and global commercial teams.

· Improve availability and backorder support by connecting inventory, production schedules, component constraints and product alternatives. Ensure customer-facing responses reflect approved product information and reliable supply assumptions.

  

**Transformation and leadership accountabilities**
==================================================

**Business analytics and decision support**
-------------------------------------------

· Build a prioritized analytics portfolio covering inventory exposure, expiry and obsolescence, component shortages, kit revisions, product availability, quotation economics, margin drivers and time to market.

· Translate business questions into data requirements, agreed definitions and actionable dashboards. Challenge data quality, assumptions and analytical conclusions, and ensure insights lead to documented decisions and follow-up actions.

**Automation and AI**
---------------------

· Sponsor process simplification and automation using suitable tools such as Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, RPA and system integrations. Define requirements, controls, testing, adoption and support arrangements with Technology partners.

· Develop AI use cases for extracting and validating product information, comparing document versions, assisting product cross referencing, summarizing exceptions and supporting stakeholder queries. Define evaluation criteria and human review for technical, quality and regulatory content.

· Own the business case and benefits realization for each initiative. Establish a baseline, measure capacity released and improvements in quality or cycle time, and validate financial benefits with Finance while accounting for delivery and ongoing support costs.

**People and capability leadership**
------------------------------------

· Lead managers, team leaders, analysts and domain specialists across the combined portfolio. Define accountabilities, performance expectations, succession coverage and decision rights at each level.

· Build specialist career paths in product lifecycle operations, product data, technical documentation, analytics and automation. Recruit and develop talent capable of taking on more complex global responsibilities.

· Create a common culture of ownership, problem solving and continuous learning. Coach leaders through change, resolve competing priorities and maintain employee engagement as scope and ways of working evolve.

**Global partnership and operational governance**
-------------------------------------------------

· Establish one service catalogue, demand and capacity process, performance scorecard and escalation framework. Lead business reviews with global stakeholders and align resources to business value, risk and service commitments.

· Manage delivery quality, turnaround time, backlog, productivity, controls, budget and continuity within delegated authority. Maintain current procedures, training records, access controls and reliable backup coverage.

· Shape a phased capability roadmap and lead new scope discovery, transition planning, knowledge transfer and stabilization. Define acceptance criteria, service ownership and controls before assuming additional work.

  

**Work Experience & Required Skills:**

· Typically 15 or more years of progressive experience across product operations, product lifecycle management, supply chain, technical business operations or global capability environments, with substantial responsibility for complex delivery portfolios.

· Demonstrated experience leading managers or team leaders across multiple specialist teams, including performance management, succession development, organizational change and global stakeholder engagement.

· Strong understanding of product and component data, bills of materials, lifecycle changes and cross-functional dependencies. Relevant experience may come from medical devices, healthcare products or other complex manufactured-product businesses.

· Proven delivery of analytics and automation initiatives with measurable business outcomes. Ability to assess analytical logic, data quality, technology options and benefits rather than relying solely on project status reporting.

· Commercial and operational acumen sufficient to evaluate inventory exposure, cost and margin implications, service trade-offs and the business case for capability expansion.

· Ability to work with senior international stakeholders, influence decisions without direct authority, communicate complex issues clearly and lead teams through ambiguity.

  

**Educational Qualification:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, supply chain, operations, business or a relevant discipline. An MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred. Lean Six Sigma, project management, supply chain or product lifecycle qualifications are useful where supported by delivery experience.
* Preferred exposure includes regulated product documentation, kitting or configurable products, product information management and ERP systems, Power BI and the Microsoft Power Platform.
* Familiarity with SQL, data modeling, RPA or AI implementation strengthens the profile.
Relevant environments in the current scope include SAP, QAD, AS400, PIM, Medpack, NetQuote, Workfront and Smartsheet; expertise in every platform is not required.

Medline India was setup in 2010 in Pune, primarily as an offshore Development centre and to augment resources for Medline Industries LP headquartered in Chicago, USA. We are a 1500+ strong and growing team of technology, finance & and business support professionals who support our businesses worldwide towards a mission to make healthcare run better. We are proud to be certified as a ‘Great Place to Work’ by the Great Place to Work Institute® (India) for the duration May 2023 – May 2024.
  
We are an organization with a conducive work environment, ample opportunities to learn, contribute and grow with a highly empowered & engaged team. We encourage our people to share their best ideas and create new opportunities for our customers and ourselves to work together to solve today’s toughest healthcare challenges.

Established in 1966, Medline Industries LP is a renowned global healthcare organization boasting 56 years of consecutive sales growth, exceeding $21 billion in annual sales. With a workforce of over 36,000 professionals spread across the globe, we operate in more than 125 countries and territories. As the largest privately held manufacturer and distributor of medical supplies in the United States, Medline is uniquely positioned to offer comprehensive products, education, and support across the continuum of care.
  
At present, Medline Industries, LP holds the esteemed position as the #1 market leader, delivering an extensive portfolio of over 550,000 medical products and clinical solutions. **About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced **Technical Product Manager** to guide how changes are planned and implemented on our backend-heavy fintech platform, built on Java, Spring Boot, Groovy and microservices, with MongoDB and a Vue.js frontend. In this role, you will be the central review point for platform changes, working with engineering, QA and business teams so that each change is well analysed, well designed and documented before development begins.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Use Case Analysis:** Work with business and product stakeholders to understand requirements, define use cases and user flows, and confirm expected behaviour before work is taken up.
* **Edge Case Identification:** Identify edge cases, exception scenarios and failure conditions for each change, and make sure they are covered in the design and test plans.
* **Product Design with Technical Analysis:** Translate requirements into product designs supported by technical analysis, covering service placement, API contracts, data model changes and integration points.
* **Change Review & Implementation Approach:** Review change requests, assess their impact across microservices, APIs, MongoDB collections and downstream consumers, and agree on the implementation approach with engineering.
* **Data & Configuration Changes:** Guide changes to MongoDB document structures, indexes and data migrations, as well as Groovy-based scripts and configurations, with attention to backward compatibility.
* **Documentation & Traceability:** Maintain clear records linking requirements, design decisions, code changes and releases, including release and rollback plans for each change.
* **Compliance:** Help ensure product features and technical changes follow applicable financial regulations and standards (e.g., PCI-DSS, GDPR, SOC2) and support audit needs.
* **Agile Delivery:** Lead sprint planning, backlog grooming and retrospectives, with epics and user stories that include clear acceptance criteria and technical detail.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Act as the technical point of contact between engineering, QA, compliance and business teams.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* **Overall Experience:** 10+ years in Technical Product Management, Technical Program Management or Software Engineering, including at least 4–5 years of hands-on backend development or technical leadership in Java and Spring Boot.
* **Industry Experience:** At least 5 years in a fintech organisation (e.g., payments, banking technology, wealth management, lending).
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related field.
* **Technical Skills:** Good understanding of microservices architecture, including service boundaries, inter-service communication and API contract management; practical experience with MongoDB data modelling, indexing and production data changes; working knowledge of Groovy; familiarity with Vue.js to assess the frontend impact of backend changes.
* **Analytical Skills:** Experience in use case analysis, edge case identification and writing functional and technical specifications.
* **Tools:** Experience with Confluence, Jira and Swagger/Open API, and the ability to read and review code, design documents and API specifications.
* **Communication:** Ability to explain technical constraints and trade-offs clearly to business stakeholders.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience moving teams from legacy systems to modern cloud infrastructure.
* Familiarity with compliance audits and building features for regulatory reporting.
* Certifications such as CSPO, PMP or AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner.

Role: SAP FICO PM  
Function: Enterprise Technology Solutions – Finance Products, Europe  
Experience: 10–14 years in SAP Finance, including 4+ years owning solution design and delivery of change through a partner-led development team  
Reporting to: Finance Products Lead, Europe

Role Purpose

Own the SAP Finance (FICO) product for Europe on the build-and-change side. The role is the accountable interface between European Finance business users and the Accenture development pod: converting business demand into the right solution design, getting it built and released on time and to quality, and owning every dependency the partner team will not own — integration, cross-functional, data, security and infrastructure.

This is a product ownership role, not a coordination role. The person is expected to have an opinion on the design, to say no to the wrong design, and to be credible in front of both a Finance Controller and an Accenture solution architect.

Key Responsibilities

Demand and solution design ownership

* Own the European Finance change pipeline end to end: intake, qualification, business case challenge, solution option analysis, prioritisation with process owners, and release planning.
* Work with business users and process owners to get to the *best* solution rather than the first one proposed — standard SAP over custom, global template over local workaround, reuse over rebuild. Document and defend the rationale.
* Review and sign off functional specifications, solution design documents and architecture decisions produced by the Accenture solution managers before build starts; ensure design fits the global template, the S/4HANA roadmap and the enterprise architecture guardrails.
* Assess and challenge impact on adjacent processes — O2C, P2P, R2R, tax, treasury, costing, intercompany, statutory and group reporting — before committing to a design.
* Maintain the product backlog, roadmap and release calendar for Finance applications in Europe, with clear prioritisation logic visible to stakeholders.

Managing the Accenture delivery team

* Manage the Accenture pod covering solution managers, functional consultants, developers and testers: work allocation, sprint or release commitments, estimate review, dependency clearing and progress tracking.
* Hold the partner accountable for design quality, build quality, unit testing, documentation and on-time delivery; review estimates critically and challenge padding, scope creep and rebadged effort.
* Run the delivery governance cadence — design authority reviews, daily/weekly stand-ups, sprint or release reviews, defect triage, go/no-go decisions — and escalate early when a date is at risk.
* Own the quality gates the partner delivers into: design review, code review/ATC, SIT, UAT entry and exit criteria, cutover readiness and hypercare exit.
* Drive knowledge retention, documentation standards and reduced key-person dependency across the pod; sign off knowledge transfer before resource rotation.

Cross-team liaison (dependencies outside the partner scope)

This is a core part of the role, not an occasional extra. The Accenture team will not own these; the Product Manager does.

* Integration / BTP team — specify and drive interface requirements, iFlow design on SAP Integration Suite/CPI, API and event design, error handling and monitoring (AIF), interface testing windows and cutover sequencing.
* Data and MDM teams — master data readiness, data quality rules, migration and conversion objects, ownership of data-related design decisions.
* Security and GRC — role design, segregation-of-duties impact, access approvals and audit/SOX evidence for changes.
* Basis / infrastructure / transport management — landscape availability, transport sequencing across releases, system refresh impact on in-flight change.
* Other functional product teams and regional/global template owners — cross-module dependencies, template change requests, alignment where a European requirement touches the global core.
* Third-party and downstream systems — banking, tax engines, consolidation and reporting platforms, local statutory tools.
* Own the dependency and risk register for the Finance product; chase, unblock and escalate rather than waiting to be told a dependency has slipped.

Stakeholder management and delivery accountability

* Act as the trusted point of contact for European Finance leadership, Controllers, Shared Service Centres and country Finance teams; communicate design trade-offs, timelines and constraints in business language.
* Manage expectations honestly on scope, cost and date — including saying no, or not yet, with a reasoned alternative.
* Own the plan and the date: baseline it, track it, report status without varnish, and land releases on time with no unmanaged surprises at cutover.
* Protect the financial close calendar — no release, cutover or freeze-window decision that puts month-end, quarter-end or year-end close at risk.
* Represent the Finance product in change advisory boards, architecture forums and release governance.

Required Skills & Experience

* 10–14 years in SAP with strong hands-on functional depth in FICO — GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, Banking, Taxation, Product Costing, CO-PA, Intercompany, period-end close. S/4HANA experience expected.
* Proven track record of owning solution design and delivering change through a third-party system integrator (Accenture, TCS, Infosys, Capgemini, IBM or similar) — managing their solution managers and developers, not just receiving their output.
* Demonstrated experience in a large global FMCG/CPG environment of large scale — multi-country, multi-company-code, multi-currency, global template with local statutory variance, high transaction volumes, complex trade and promotional accounting.
* Strong integration literacy: able to write and challenge an interface requirement, understand SAP BTP / Integration Suite (CPI) patterns, IDocs, APIs and events, and debug integration issues alongside technical teams.
* Cross-module fluency across FI/CO to MM, SD, PP, and to reporting and consolidation layers; able to spot the downstream impact of a Finance design decision.
* Product management discipline: backlog and roadmap ownership, prioritisation frameworks, requirement writing, release planning, benefits tracking.
* Delivery methods: Agile/Scrum and SAFe alongside stage-gated project delivery; comfortable with Jira or Azure DevOps and with ServiceNow-based change governance.
* Change and release governance: ChaRM / Solution Manager / Cloud ALM, transport discipline, CAB, emergency change protocols, audit-ready traceability.
* Excellent written and spoken English; ability to influence senior Finance stakeholders and hold a partner to account without escalating everything.

Good to Have

* Experience with Central Finance, Group Reporting, Universal Journal, or a Finance transformation/S/4 conversion programme.
* European statutory, VAT/e-invoicing, and local compliance exposure (e-invoicing mandates, SAF-T, Intrastat)
