description:
**Senior Product Manager – Core Data and Decision Intelligence**  
  
**Target in India | L6**  
  
**About Us**  
  
As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America’s leading retailers.  
  
Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.  
  
Target is investing in the next generation of **intelligent store experiences** that connect operational, digital and physical environments to create smarter outcomes for guests, team members and the business.  
  
Our Core Intelligence Product teams are building the foundational capabilities that enable Target’s stores to **understand what is happening, anticipate what matters, recommend the right actions, and continuously learn from outcomes**.  
  
**About the Job – Senior Product Manager, Core Data and Decision Intelligence**  
  
What if a store could understand its operating environment in real time, recognize what matters most and intelligently recommend what should happen next?  
  
That is the future our **Core Data and Intelligence** teams are working toward.  
  
As a Senior Product Manager for Core Intelligence, you will build highly technical products that transform operational and physical signals into trusted intelligence that powers smarter Store decisions and experiences.  
  
You will own a complex intelligence product end-to-end—from deeply understanding the problem and developing product strategy through discovery, experimentation, delivery and measurement of outcomes.  
  
You will work side-by-side with Engineering and Data Science and partner with UX, Store Operations and other Product teams to build scalable capabilities that can power multiple workflows and experiences across Target.  
  
**Product Strategy & Ownership**

* Own the vision, strategy, roadmap and outcomes for a complex Core Intelligence product.
* Develop a deep understanding of Store operations, users and the decisions your product is intended to improve.
* Translate customer and business problems into clear product opportunities and hypotheses.
* Balance immediate use cases with development of reusable capabilities that can scale across Target.
* Define meaningful product health and outcome metrics and use them to drive prioritization and investment decisions.

**Discovery & Intelligence Product Development**

* Lead continuous discovery with Engineering, Data Science, UX, Operations and consuming Product teams.
* Explore how operational context, data science, AI/ML and emerging technologies can solve meaningful Store problems.
* Design experiments and prototypes to test hypotheses before scaling solutions.
* Partner closely with Data Science to define intelligence quality, confidence and feedback mechanisms.
* Build products that continuously learn and improve through real-world outcomes.
* Make thoughtful trade-offs across accuracy, latency, explainability, scalability and business value.

**Product Delivery & Outcomes**

* Own and prioritize the product backlog while maintaining clear connection to strategy and outcomes.
* Partner with Engineering and Data Science throughout discovery, development, launch and learning.
* Make autonomous product decisions within your product area.
* Establish adoption, product-health and outcome measures.
* Continuously evaluate whether the product is solving the intended problem and adjust strategy based on evidence.
* Ensure capabilities are reliable, reusable and extensible where appropriate.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Build trusted partnerships across Engineering, Data Science, UX, Store Operations and Product teams.
* Influence partners and stakeholders through strong product thinking, evidence and storytelling.
* Clearly communicate product strategy, customer problems, trade-offs and outcomes.
* Navigate dependencies across a complex enterprise ecosystem.
* Contribute to the broader Core Intelligence strategy and identify opportunities for reuse across Store experiences.

**About You**

* 4-year college degree or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of Product Management or relevant product experience.
* Experience owning complex, technical or data-intensive products.
* Strong product discovery and problem-solving capabilities.
* Comfortable partnering deeply with Engineering and Data Science.
* Familiarity with AI/ML, data products, recommendation systems or intelligent platforms is preferred.
* Ability to translate complex technology into intuitive customer and business outcomes.
* Strong analytical thinking and ability to make decisions using imperfect information.
* Excellent communication and cross-functional influence skills.
* Curious, comfortable with ambiguity and energized by building products in emerging problem spaces.

title: Associate Product Manager/Product Manager (Reference Standards)
description:
**Description**

**Who is USP?**

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

**Brief Job Overview**

As part of the USP Programs, Regions, Operations, and Strategy (PROpS) Division, the Reference Standards Product Manager leads the development and management of the Small Molecules, Complex Generics, and General Chapters portfolio of reference standards. The Product Management function is responsible for overseeing the full product lifecycle (development to discontinuation), understanding key industry trends, applying data-driven and analytic decision making and making customer-focused recommendations that drive product portfolio growth. This role is an individual contributor who will be responsible for implementation of projects and processes that enable decisions about new and existing products. Core activities will also include the development of prioritization, forecasting, and financial models that enhance product mix, optimization and overall performance. This is a highly collaborative role that will be expected to work globally across the organization including Science, Operations, Sales, Regions, Pricing, Trade Compliance, and Marketing. As a product manager, this role will drive product strategy, lead cross-functional teams in planning product roadmaps, discount and promotion strategies and ensure the successful launch and growth of innovative, high-quality standards and solutions to drive USP’s mission and vision of improving global health.

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.

The Reference Standards Product Manager has the following responsibilities:

* Item forecasting, pricing, and margin analysis
* Develop and present business case and supporting rationale for new and existing items
* Stays abreast of industry and market trends and key competitive intelligence to drive product strategies.
* Lead pipeline prioritization efforts, aligning pipeline to segment value and organizational strategies/prioritization
* Work with Industry Programs, Science and Operations, and others to facilitate new product launches
* Support Industry Programs, Regional and Sales staff in new product training and related customer solutions
* Support continuous improvement of forecasting and product performance against key success metrics
* Manage product mix and optimization for selection and discontinuation of products that enhance profitability
* Identify new product opportunities based on customer needs, feedback, and strategic insights
* Work collaboratively with Marketing, Sales, and Regions to launch and monitor feedback and uptake of items
* Maintain and update product roadmaps to meet targeted product pipeline and growth goals.

**Who is USP Looking For?**

The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in business, Marketing or Science fields with a MBA Degree.
* Minimum three (3) to seven (7) years of professional experience in Pharmaceutical industry or related field
* At least one (1) to two (2) years managing large product portfolios across B2B and/or B2C companies and managing high performance cross-functional teams.
* Experience with financial analysis, forecasting, data and analytical tools
* Strong quantitative and critical thinking skills with ability to handle complexity and drive data-driven solutions.
* Ability to develop and present dashboards, templates and business cases supported by strong rationale, customer insights and business growth goals.
* Self-starter and highly self-motivated, assumes personal accountability for results and performance.
* Working knowledge of syndicated data and analysis, such as IQVIA, Cortellis, Dailymed, etc
* Knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint
* Strong written and verbal communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

None, this is an individual contributor role.

**Benefits**

USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.

Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.

**Job Category** Technical Programs

**Job Type** Full-Time

LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.

  

LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 65 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.

  

**OUR PEOPLE:**

People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.

  

We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.

  

**ROLE PROFILE:**
-----------------

The Strategic Partner Operations team supports the commercial management of LSEG's Strategic Partner ecosystem including Co-Sell and Re-Sell Partners. The team is responsible for maintaining accurate partner reporting, supporting revenue share and Co-Sell reporting processes, and providing a reliable view of the Partner book of business. The team works closely with Partner Directors, Finance and Operations to improve data quality, reporting and operational processes.

The team is also responsible for any improvements in process that minimize manual tasks and improves revenue recognition. The team enables leaders and Partner Directors to make better-informed decisions by ensuring that Co-Sell Partner reporting is complete, accurate, timely and translated into actionable insight.

The team is responsible for maintaining and analysing the Partner book of business, consolidating reporting received from partners and internal systems, identifying trends and data-quality gaps, and improving the processes used to track end-client relationships, revenue, and partner performance.

The team will also support the development and maintenance of a centralised global repository for Strategic Partner agreements, initially focused on Co-Sell agreements. This will provide a reliable source of truth for partner contracts, improve accessibility and governance, and support greater consistency in how contractual information is maintained across the organisation.

  

**ROLE SUMMARY:**
-----------------

The successful candidate will support and be a member of the Global Strategic Partners organisation. The key accountability will be to support and maintain reporting across the Co-Sell Partner portfolio and maintaining a trusted, useful view of the Co-Sell and Re-Sell book of business.

The role will involve collecting and validating partner reporting, maintaining accurate partner and end-client data, reconciling information across internal systems, producing regular reporting and supporting Partner Directors with analysis. The successful candidate will also support the creation and ongoing maintenance of a centralised global repository of Co-Sell Partner agreements, ensuring contracts and key information are accurately captured, organised and accessible, while supporting improvements to reporting processes and standards as the Co-Sell and Re-Sell business grows.

  
  

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:**
-------------------------

* Support the collection, consolidation and analysis of reporting received from Co-Sell Partners, ensuring submissions are timely, complete and aligned to agreed reporting requirements.

* Maintain the Co-Sell book of business as a reliable source of truth, including partner, end-client, revenue, product, geographic information.

* Support the development and maintenance of a centralised global repository for Co-Sell Partner agreements, consolidating existing contracts and ensuring documentation is complete, accurate and accessible.

* Maintain key contractual information and support ongoing governance of the repository, working with Partner Directors and relevant teams to identify missing agreements or information and keep records current.

* Reconcile partner reported information against internal systems and identify data-quality issues or discrepancies.

* Produce regular reports and dashboards showing Partner performance, revenue, end-client activity and key trends.

* Provide analytical and ad-hoc support to Partner Directors and the Global Strategic Partners leadership team that help prioritise partner opportunities, account activity and commercial focus.

* Identify gaps or potential non-compliance in reporting, or partner activity and coordinate with relevant participants to investigate and resolve issues.

* Partner with Finance, and other teams to improve the consistency of Co-Sell revenue attribution

  

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**
----------------------

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis, with the ability to work confidently with large datasets.

* Experience supporting or analysing a book of business, customer portfolio, partner portfolio or comparable commercial dataset.

* Experience working with CRM, reporting and workflow platforms such as Salesforce, Power BI, or equivalent tools.

* Ability to interpret commercial information and, where required, read agreements or commercial rules to understand reporting obligations and data definitions.

* Good analytical skills and a strong attention to detail, with the ability to identify patterns, anomalies and inconsistencies in complex data.

* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn detailed analysis into concise and actionable messages for senior audiences.

* A strong commitment to data quality, operational rigor and continuous improvement.

------------------------------

As a member of the Global Strategic Partners organisation, you will gain exposure to some of LSEG's most important Co-Sell and Re-Sell Partners and to the breadth of Data & Analytics and Risk Intelligence products and services that underpin those relationships.

You will work closely with Partner Directors and Managers, Sales, Finance, Product, Operations and other specialist teams, giving you a broad understanding of how strategic partnerships are managed and how partner ecosystems contribute to LSEG's growth.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

  

**Job Description**

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Serve as the marketing point of contact for the on‑market patient monitoring platform.
  + Attend and represent marketing in core team meetings, ensuring market needs, customer requirements, and commercial considerations are clearly communicated.
  + Perform change control market impact assessments and fully own any associated marketing actions or deliverables.
  + Partner cross‑functionally to anticipate supply risks, support mitigation plans, and communicate impacts to regional teams.
  + Lead and manage end‑of‑life / end‑of‑sales (EOS) communications, including alignment with countries, commercial teams, and cross‑functional partners.
* Serve as the marketing representative for multiple digital product core teams and related change‑control processes, ensuring accurate and timely representation of commercial implications.
* Take ownership of synthesizing cross-functional outputs, identifying risks and opportunities, and translating meeting outcomes into clear, strategic recommendations.
* Support product launches by developing, updating, and delivering training materials, collateral, and business case inputs.
* Ensure all stage‑gate requirements are met with high‑quality marketing deliverables.
* Support competitive landscape monitoring and basic market research needs.
* Maintain comprehensive visibility into the digital product install base, active implementations, and upcoming or completed upgrades, ensuring marketing has full situational awareness to anticipate market impacts and communicate effectively with global partners.
* Monitor and elevate any issues impacting commercial performance or market experience.
* Assist with identifying unmet needs or opportunities for incremental portfolio improvements.
* Analyze and assess portfolio performance, including revenue, demand, supply, and quality indicators.
* Provide ongoing status updates, insights, and mitigation plans to address performance gaps or emerging risks.
* **8-12 years** of professional experience required

title: Associate Product Manager / Product Manager
description:
**About Glomo**
---------------

Glomo is the regulated infrastructure layer that financial platforms build on for cross-border money movement out of India. We hold the licences, the bank integrations, the compliance engine and the settlement rails, and run them behind our clients' own brands.

Brokers, wealth platforms, AMCs, exporters and other businesses use Glomo to onboard their customers, run KYC and compliance checks, move and settle funds across borders, and reconcile it all back into their own systems. Our products span LRS remittances, global investing, card issuance and treasury.

Glomo is regulated by IFSCA through its GIFT City entity. Compliance is part of the product, and every PM here treats it that way.

**The role**
------------

We are hiring an Associate Product Manager / Product Manager, reporting directly to the founders. Level depends on experience.

This is a business product role. At Glomo, PMs sell: you will be in the room with merchants from the first conversation, and you will be accountable for the deal as much as the spec. You are not a feature desk for the sales team. You understand the customer well enough to decide what we should build for them, and what we should not.

You will join sales calls and demos, bring what you learn back to the product team, help shape the roadmap with them, write specs for the features you own, ship them with engineering, and take merchants live.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Sell.** Run discovery and demos, map a merchant's needs onto Glomo's products, and work with sales to close.
* **Shape the roadmap.** Bring merchant feedback and market insight to the product team, and work with them to prioritise what we build.
* **Write and ship.** Turn merchant needs into clear PRDs and user flows for the features you own. Work with engineering and design through launch.
* **Take merchants live.** Drive integration and onboarding, and unblock issues across ops, compliance and the merchant's own team.
* **Track adoption.** Watch usage and conversion, find where users drop off, and fix it.
* **Work inside the rules.** Partner with compliance, legal and risk so products meet IFSCA and FEMA/LRS requirements from day one.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 2+ years of work experience, including a client-facing sales role: account executive, inside sales, pre-sales or enterprise BD, preferably selling software or tech.
* MBA from a premier Indian business school.
* You can run a discovery call and a demo, handle objections, and manage a client relationship.
* Structured thinking and clear writing. You can turn a messy customer problem into a simple spec.
* Comfortable with data: Excel, and ideally basic SQL, to read a funnel and size an opportunity.
* You use AI tools effectively in your day-to-day work, for research, analysis, writing specs and prototyping, and you know where they fall short.
* Curious about how technical products work, and able to hold a conversation with engineers about APIs and integrations.
* You move fast, take ownership, and follow through without being chased.

**Good to have**
----------------

* Experience in financial services: banking, payments, fintech, broking, wealth management or mutual funds.
* Exposure to cross-border payments, or working knowledge of LRS, FEMA or KYC/AML.
* A product internship or prior product stint.
* Early-stage startup experience.
* An engineering undergraduate degree.

**Why Glomo**
-------------

* Work directly with the founders on a small team.
* Own real merchant relationships and real product outcomes from your first month.
* Build regulated cross-border infrastructure that brokers, AMCs and payment platforms run on.

The Outbound and Flow team within Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) is looking for an experienced Product Manager (Technical) to own the vision and strategy for Routing and Mansort products, based out of Bangalore. Our team provides the products and services responsible for outbound fulfillment — ingesting shipments from upstream systems (SCOT) and processing them through picking, packing, and shipping. Our vision is to improve customer experience — Delivery Estimate Accuracy (DEA), Speed, Quality, and Cost — while improving associate safety and simplifying our operations. We do so by building products that are highly reliable, resilient, self-healing, scalable, extensible, and designed from the start with a focus on the safety and accessibility of our workforce.  
As a Product Manager (Technical) — L6 for Routing and Mansort, you will define, execute, and deliver a product roadmap that optimizes how units and packages are routed through the fulfillment center and how manual sortation (Mansort) operations are streamlined for throughput, quality, and cost. You will strongly influence the strategy and vision for the group, and develop and maintain product roadmaps and features grounded in team strategy. This role is inherently cross-functional — you will work closely with engineering, science, operations, and business teams across geographies to launch features and build the tools and mechanisms that scale Routing and Mansort worldwide.  
A successful candidate will be highly analytical, able to work extremely effectively in a matrix organization, and adept at synthesizing a variety of technologies and capabilities into high-quality, simple products, features, and applications. You will identify opportunities to make FC operations more efficient, and drive the design and development of software features to address them — leveraging and expanding current initiatives in Primitives and GenAI across the organization.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap priorities by working backward from customer needs, conducting research, analyzing usage data and market trends, and translating insights into clear problem statements and requirements.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration with engineering, design, science, finance, and operations partners to deliver products on time and with high quality, aligning stakeholders and making smart trade-offs when data is incomplete.
* Own the end-to-end product lifecycle from concept through launch and beyond, including defining success criteria and key performance indicators, monitoring operational health, and iterating based on performance metrics and customer feedback.

* Leverage generative AI tools and emerging technologies to accelerate development cycles, improve decision-making, and unlock new opportunities for product innovation.

  
About the team  
AFT owns and operates the AFT Warehouse Management System (WMS) and select hardware — these technologies automate, orchestrate, and direct fulfillment in Amazon Robotics sort and non-sort buildings, traditional sort and non-sort buildings, IXDs, Fresh, Pantry, and Quick Deploy sites. AFT owns network infrastructure and devices in all building types including Sort Centers and Last Mile sites, and owns labor planning and scheduling technology leveraged for Fulfillment Centers in NA and EU and Sort Centers in NA.

Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) powers Amazon's global fulfillment network. description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. **OVERVIEW**  
The “Insights and Analytics” organization within General Mills’ Strategy and Growth function is responsible to deliver integrated consumer, customer, category, and business performance insights to power smarter, faster decisions and next-best actions, enabling precision in brand strategies, campaign execution, media and investment optimization across our US businesses and brands. The Insights and Analytics org has integrated teams operating from our Minneapolis and India offices. This is a newly created agentic AI role within our HQ Marketing Operations – Digital Transformation org, and will be based in our India office.

As the Agentic Search - Assistant Manager, you will be a key part of General Mills’ Marketing Activation and Operations team, helping translate real-time data signals into prioritized actions that improve the visibility, accuracy and representation of our brands in leading AI systems. This role will sit at the intersection of data and insight generation, with a focus on interpreting regular outputs from LLM (large language model) optimization partners and converting those outputs into clear, actionable recommendations for the broader AEO (answer engine optimization) team. You will regularly receive and analyze data from third-party vendors, identify what the results mean for content, help inform optimization decisions, map the phasing of recommended actions, and coordinate implementation with cross-functional partners. In addition, you will be directly responsible for hiring, mentoring, and coaching another Agentic AI Analyst, who will be reporting to you. As a thought leader, you will be building cross-functional relationships, and working across marketing, content, and operations teams to bring in key insights that are actionable and help us show up in the agentic results.

This role is ideal for a highly curious, detail-oriented analyst who enjoys working through complex datasets, finding the story in the data, and helping teams move from insight to action.

Based in the General Mills India Center (GIC), this role will operate as part of General Mills’ global model, with day-to-day work direction and priorities closely connected to U.S.-based functional partners and managers.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

  

* **Data Analysis & Performance Diagnostics:** Analyze large, nuanced datasets from LLM optimization platforms to diagnose what is working, what is not, and where search visibility can be improved.
* **Market & Competitor Trend Tracking:** Maintain a proactive external view of relevant digital topics, retailer landscapes, and competitor movements to surface emerging generative search trends for internal teams.
* **Strategic Planning & Prioritization:** Translate complex, rapidly evolving AI engine outputs into prioritized, phased optimization plans that focus resources on the highest-value business opportunities.
* **Cross-Functional Implementation:** Coordinate closely with cross-functional partners to support the accurate, timely execution of approved optimization initiatives.
* **Stakeholder Reporting & Capability Building:** Track optimization outcomes, maintain organized reporting, and surface risks and follow-up opportunities to stakeholders while documenting learnings to refine the team's analytical approach over time.
* **Global Operating Model Support:** Enable a consistent, scalable way of working between U.S.- and India-based teams through proactive communication, strong organization, and clear documentation.
* **Pillar Leadership:** Build a high performing Agentic Analysis team in GIC, as an extension on the US Marketing Operations – Digital Transformation team. This involves both building the team, being responsible for deliverables – learning, context and acumen, and building capabilities/tools that may be required for the pillar.
* **Influence and Stakeholder Management:** Effectively communicate and provide leadership in meetings, influence decision making by proactively reaching out to stakeholders, ensuring timelines are met, meetings are productive and priorities are met timely.
* Mentor and coach the associate in India on best practices and remove roadblocks if any, with support from your manager
* Facilitate collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement within the larger Agentic Search team
Stay current on industry trends and consumer behavior insights, applying knowledge to refine and inform AI search optimization strategies.

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Computer Science, IT, Data Analytics, or a related field, with an MBA in Marketing / International Business.
